rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 2 sites — Site 1: Philips Ingenia MRI scanner (n=45 TD), Site 2: Siemens Verio MRI scanner (n=174 TD)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The MRI data of 283 children (164 ASD with DD/ID, 74 ASD without DD/ID, and 45 TD) were collected at site 1 with a Philips Ingenia MRI scanner. And MRI data of 747 children (399 ASD with DD/ID, 138 ASD without DD/ID, 36 DD/ID, and 174 TD) were collected at site 2 with a Siemens Verio MRI scanner."
rci1_using_msad.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: Methods / MRI data acquisition, quality control and processing

rci2_using_epd.detail: All data from in-house cohort: Shanghai Autism Early Developmental (SAED) Cohort, recruited from Xinhua Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University. No established public datasets (EPDs) used for normative model training.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Participants were recruited from a neurodevelopmental project - Shanghai Autism Early Development Cohort [40]. All children were recruited from those who had visited the Department of Developmental Behaviour and Children Health Care, Xinhua Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University"
